description:
Rough, tough, and gruff director by day. Fluffy oaf of a bear by night. Director Moon's top-secret double life takes a turn for the worse when his troublemaker intern, Lee hits the scene. Her goal is to become Moon's official secretary, but Moon will stop at nothing to hide his unstoppable, nightly cuddliness!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=792379), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8277904)
